kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice report-ab-metric-group --ab-metric-group-id 1 --instance-id pairec-cn-test1 --report-type Offline --scene-id 1 --experiment-group-id 3 --experiment-ids 3,4,5 --base-experiment-id 3 --time-statistics-method Hour --dimension-fields '{"gender":"man"}' --start-date 2021-07-01 --end-date 2021-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReportABMetricGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AB metric group
parameters.name: ab_metric_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the report.

Realtime: real-time report.

Offline: offline report.

Market: dashboard report
parameters.help_zh:
报表类型。

Realtime-实时报表

Offline-离线报表

Market-大盘报表
parameters.name: report_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scene. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402581.html operation to obtain the scene ID
parameters.name: scene_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the experiment group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402573.html operation to obtain the ID of the experiment group. This parameter is required for offline and real-time reports
parameters.help_zh: 实验组ID，可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402573.html获取（离线、实时报表需要）
parameters.name: experiment_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the experiments. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402582.html operation to obtain the IDs of the experiments
parameters.name: experiment_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the base experiment
parameters.name: base_experiment_id

parameters.help_en:
The time statistics method. This parameter is required for real-time reports.

Hour: The statistics are collected by hour.

Day: The statistics are accumulated from 00:00 on the current day
parameters.help_zh:
统计时间类型（实时报表需要）。

Hour-按小时统计。

Day-从当日0点开始累加
parameters.name: time_statistics_method
